notes.title: In game photo editor
notes.content:
So, I added an in-game Photo editor!

It's very straightforward to use it:

[b]
Press "P' to take a screenshot (all controls are at the bottom of the widget)
Press "L" to open your gallery of all your amazing work!
[/b]

How can I upload my work into Steam artwork? 
Click here to watch the tutorial


Bugs:
- Fixed Enemy going through [u]certain trees[/u]
- Some Achievements don't show
- made the main menu ugly 

I did more stuff but I forgot and I didn't kept track,
